rows.ja: 連携・パートナー(Sprinklrの年次報告に記載)
rows.en: Integrations & partners (named in Sprinklr's annual report)

companies.name: アドビ
companies.sub: クリエイティブソフト

relations.text: 年次報告が、連携先として挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names it among its marketplace integrations

source.label: Sprinklr 10-K
source.quote: Sprinklr marketplace integrations include 80+ out-of-the-box connectors with CRMs, CDPs, DAMs, and Data Visualization, as well as with other enterprise platforms like Microsoft, Salesforce, Adobe, Google, Oracle, SAP and ServiceNow.

relations.text: 年次報告が、パートナーの例として挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report names it among its partner examples

source.label: Sprinklr 10-K
source.quote: We work with agencies and partners across nine different partner categories, including System Integrators, Transformational partners and Resellers, which includes partners such as Microsoft, Accenture, Deloitte, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Adobe, Oracle and others.

relations.text: Sprout Socialの年次報告が、競合としてSprinklrを挙げている
relations.text_en: Sprout Social's annual report names Sprinklr as a competitor

source.label: Sprout Social 10-K
source.quote: We primarily face competition from other social media management companies such as Hootsuite, Khoros and Sprinklr, as well as a range of independent point solutions.
